{"query_id":8675927,"user_id":null,"team_id":953543,"version":1,"name":"D10: HyperEVM-HyperCore Interface (30d)","description":"Dashboard 10: HyperEVM-HyperCore Interaction — last 30 complete UTC days; runtime evidence dashboard for Visualization 10.","tags":[],"query":"-- Dashboard 10: HyperEVM and HyperCore Interaction — runtime evidence
WITH filtered_interactions AS (
    SELECT
        block_date,
        tx_hash,
        "from" AS caller_address,
        CASE
            WHEN "to" = 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 THEN 'corewriter_write'
            ELSE 'hypercore_read_precompile'
        END AS interaction_type
    FROM hyperevm.traces
    WHERE block_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY
      AND block_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND "to" IN (
          0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000800,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000801,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000802,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000803,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000804,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000805,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000806,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000807,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000808,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000809,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080a,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080b,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080c,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080d,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080e,
          0x000000000000000000000000000000000000080f,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000810,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000811,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000812,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000813,
          0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000814
      )
)

SELECT
    block_date AS date,
    interaction_type,
    COUNT(*) AS interaction_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS unique_transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT caller_address) AS unique_callers
FROM filtered_interactions
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY date, interaction_type;","parameters":[],"is_archived":false,"is_private":false,"is_temp":true,"latest_execution_id":"01M27GDBJNJ3VVPBJEBR8X9357","latest_execution_state":"QUERY_STATE_COMPLETED"}
